scientific_integrity: The analytic reduction and a standalone exact rational-field enumeration, not numerical sampling, support the formula and nine equality configurations. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only chord-parallel enclosing quadrilaterals of the regular nonagon and its invertible affine images; no unrestricted minimum or general Kuperberg conjecture is determined. Historical equivalent computations may exist.
title: Exact chord-quadrilateral area and optimizer classification for a regular nonagon
